rows.note: Use 即時 as the all-purpose choice for something happening with no delay.

example.english: I got an instantaneous response when I pressed the button.
example.traditional: 我一撳掣，畫面即時彈出嚟。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 gam6 zai3 waa2 min2 zik1 si4 daan6 ceot1 lai4

rows.note: Use 瞬間 when emphasizing that the event itself takes only an imperceptibly brief moment.

example.english: The fireworks vanished in an instantaneous flash.
example.traditional: 煙花喺天空瞬間消失咗。
example.jyutping: jin1 faa1 hai2 tin1 hung1 seon3 gaan1 siu1 sat1 zo2
